title: Champ (Irish Spring Onion Mash)
summary: Floury potatoes boiled and steamed dry, then mashed with hot milk infused with spring onions, butter and seasoning, and served with a pool of butter in the centre.

ingredients.item: floury potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Cover the potatoes with cold water, bring to the boil and simmer for 15-20 min until completely tender. Drain well and return to the pan over low heat for 1 min to steam off excess moisture.

steps.title: Infuse the milk
steps.text: Meanwhile, warm the spring onions in the milk with the 50 g butter, salt and pepper over low heat for 3-4 min, until the butter melts and the onions soften.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Mash the potatoes until smooth, then beat in the hot spring onion milk.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile into a warm dish, make a well in the centre and drop in the remaining butter to melt into a pool.

tips: Floury potatoes such as Maris Piper or russet give the fluffiest result.
Keep the milk hot; cold milk makes mash gluey.
Chopped chives or a few peas are common variations.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days. Reheat with a splash of milk until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
